subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should OpenClaw accept the existing 2 MiB workspace-bootstrap cap as the new compatibility contract for all `IDENTITY.md` reads, including existing oversized files?
rationale: The bounded read prevents avoidable memory exhaustion, but it deliberately changes how previously accepted oversized identity files behave during upgrades.

options.title: Approve the shared cap
options.body: Accept the 2 MiB shared bootstrap cap as the canonical identity-file limit; the branch already preserves normal and at-cap reads and gives explicit CLI users a clear error.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility policy
options.body: Keep or redesign behavior for oversized pre-existing identity files, then update the loader, diagnostics, and boundary tests to match that product contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared cap
recommendation.body: Accept the 2 MiB shared bootstrap cap as the canonical identity-file limit; the branch already preserves normal and at-cap reads and gives explicit CLI users a clear error.
